ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var html = String(result);
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html, baseUrl);
var vs = doc.select("#__VIEWSTATE").first();
var targetDoc = doc;
if (vs != null && String(vs.attr("value")).length > 0) {
  var decoded = lzDecompressFromBase64(String(vs.attr("value")));
  if (decoded && decoded.length > 0) {
    targetDoc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(decoded, baseUrl);
  }
}
var uls = targetDoc.select("#chapterList ul, .chapter-list ul");
if (uls.size() == 0) {
  uls = targetDoc.select("ul");
}
var out = [];
for (var i = 0; i < uls.size(); i++) {
  var links = uls.get(i).select("li a[href]");
  for (var j = links.size() - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
    var a = links.get(j);
    var href = String(a.attr("href"));
    if (href.indexOf("/comic/") === -1 && href.indexOf(".html") === -1) continue;
    var name = String(a.text()).trim();
    out.push({name: name, url: href});
  }
}
JSON.stringify(out);
</js>$.[*]

"?" + qs.join("&") : ""; var headerOpt = JSON.stringify({"headers": {"Referer": "https://m.manhuagui.com/"}}); var out = []; for (var i = 0; i < images.length; i++) { var encodedPath = encodeURI(images[i]).replace(/#/g, "%23"); var imgUrl = "https://" + host + ".hamreus.com" + encodedPath + suffix; out.push(""); } out.join("\n"); }
